subject: Audit logs / access evidence request - follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@atlasfin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@atlasfin.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - audit logs & data handling

Thanks for the recap this morning, Marissa - helpful conversation. A couple follow-ups from our side on the audit logs and data access controls so our security and privacy teams can close their checklist: 

1) Can you provide an example export of the audit logs showing who accessed model usage and any data exports (CSV or PDF acceptable)? Preferably containing: timestamp, user id, action (view/export), resource id, and IP address.

2) What is Redwood's retention policy for these logs by default, and what retention options do customers have (e.g., 90/365/retained within our VPC)?

3) For PII handling: do logs ever contain raw prompt payloads or are those redacted/hashed by default in the hosted offering? If prompts are retained, are there config knobs to disable storing prompts or to purge them on request?

4) Data residency: we need confirmation that audit logs for Atlas accounts hosted in us-west-2 are stored in the US and that exports can be generated within the customer-controlled VPC option (if we move to Private).

If you can send a sample export and short answers for the bullets above that would be great - Priya is our security lead and will validate. Thanks,

Jordan
Security Operations
Atlas Financial
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@atlasfin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - audit logs & data handling

Hi Jordan / Priya -

Great questions, appreciated. See answers inline below and attaching a small sample export for your security team to review. Summary: we can provide the fields you asked for, offer configurable retention windows up to customer-defined policies, and have controls for prompt retention in hosted vs. private deployments.

1) Sample export: attached file "redwood_audit_export_2026Q1.csv" contains timestamp, internal_user, action, resource_id, ip_address, and result. It's a redacted sample (no real customer prompt text).

2) Retention: default retention for hosted accounts is 90 days for detailed logs, and 365 days for aggregated metadata. For Dedicated and Private deployments customers can configure retention via policy (we support 90/180/365/custom) and we also provide an export API for on-demand snapshots.

3) PII/prompt handling: hosted API does persist prompt/response payloads for 30 days by default for abuse monitoring and model quality; however, prompts are not included in standard audit log exports. Customers can opt out of prompt retention via account settings ("prompt_retention": "off") or choose Private deployment where prompt storage is fully under customer control. We also offer a purge API to remove prompt content on request, with confirmation once purge completes.

4) Data residency: audit logs for accounts pinned to us-west-2 are stored in that region. For Private deployments we support customer-managed storage (S3/GCS in their project) so exports and logs never traverse our multi-tenant storage.

Next steps I'd propose:
- Ben (cc) can share the fuller export with the redactions removed for Atlas if we get a signed NDA or an evidence request form from your procurement/security team.
- If Atlas prefers, we can generate a scoped export (date range + resource types) - please share the range and users you want included.

Attaching: redwood_audit_export_2026Q1.csv (sample)

Thanks - happy to jump back on a call with Priya to walk through the sample.

Best,

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@atlasfin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@atlasfin.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Discovery call recap - audit logs & data handling

Marissa - thanks for the quick answers and the sample. A few clarifying items for our compliance workflow: 

- The sample looks good. For our next step we need a scoped export covering 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31 including actions for the service account used by our analytics team (svc-analytics@atlasfin.com). Can you confirm whether the export will include the original user identifiers or only internal IDs and whether IP addresses are fully preserved?

- For the prompt retention opt-out: can you point us to the console path or API call that toggles prompt_retention to off? We want to document the exact config change for our security runbook.

- Can you also confirm retention guarantees in Dedicated (if we move to Dedicated) - specifically whether you support legal-hold style exceptions (pause deletion) and the SLA around export generation (how long to produce a scoped export once requested)?

If you can send a proposed process (one-pager) for evidence requests + an estimated timeline for producing the scoped export (and whether that will require an NDA), we can circulate internally.

Thanks,

Priya Mehta
Head of Security & Privacy
Atlas Financial
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@atlasfin.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@atlasfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap - audit logs & data handling

Hi Priya / Jordan - looping in our security operations lead (Aditya) and infra team to confirm exact fields and turnaround.

Quick answers:
- Export contents: we can include original user identifiers (email) if Atlas confirms they own those users in the account scope; otherwise exports default to internal IDs. IP addresses are preserved in full in audit exports.
- Prompt retention toggle: API endpoint is POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/settings with body {"prompt_retention": "off"} (we'll provide the exact curl in a follow-up).
- Dedicated retention/legal hold: we support hold-style exceptions; the process requires a signed request from your legal team and is implemented via a customer retention policy in the Dedicated admin console.
- SLA for scoped export: standard evidence requests for customers on an active contract are 5 business days; expedited requests can be prioritized with an SOW or under an enterprise SLA.

Action items:
- Priya: please confirm the date range (2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31 is fine) and the exact service account(s) to include (e.g., svc-analytics@atlasfin.com).
- Atlas: please share any procurement/security evidence request form or NDA you require and we'll route it to legal.
- Aditya (cc): can you prepare an exported package (CSV + PDF summary) once we get confirmation and attach to a secure transfer link?

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
